transport: AF_UNIX/SOCK_STREAM with a four-byte network-order frame length

identity.peer: Kernel-verified PID, UID and GID from SO_PEERCRED
identity.session: Claim verified against an active logind session and peer UID
identity.application: Context only for same-process QML; reserved for process-bound identity in future versions
identity.authorization: Server-side default-deny operation, permission, capability, argument and process checks from /etc/neutronos/security-authorization.json
